name: ShareLocation
description: Send your location to a contact. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.

name: ReserveRestaurant
description: Make a table reservation at a restaurant. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.

name: FindRestaurants
description: Find restaurants by location and by category. The format for values of parameters related to date is "^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$", and for parameters related to time, it is "HH:MM". Values for parameters indicating yes or no should use the boolean type.
